name: Haiku growth at a reasonable price
strategy: Sector rotation into lagging fundamentals with long-short mean-reversion discipline; long value/healthcare/financials, short semiconductor extremes, contrarian crypto recovery.
novelty: Differs from R1 (quality earnings growers) and R2 (concentrated AI-infra) by employing long-short positioning to harvest mean-reversion in mega-cap tech extremes while rotating into undervalued sectors lagging YTD. Return driver is relative-value arbitrage between overbought semis (+507% overextension) and undervalued financials/healthcare/value factors, plus crypto washout recovery—not absolute earnings growth.

positions.thesis: Financials sector rotation; net beneficiary of rate environment, lagged YTD (+11.2%), attractive valuations
Energy sector strength; commodity cycle momentum (+34.1% YTD), relative value vs. tech
Healthcare quality exposure; defensive characteristics, +21.5% YTD, steady earnings growth
Value factor diversification; mean-reversion potential as growth cools, +8.2% in 3m
Biotech growth within value; strong momentum (+14.6% last month, +82.7% YTD), cycle strength
Quality factor at reasonable multiples; lower beta growth, +21.5% YTD
Small-cap Russell 2000 3x leverage; value rotation catch-up, +106% YTD, contrarian position sizing
Bitcoin contrarian recovery; down 46% YTD, washout bottom formation, institutional adoption tailwind
Ethereum contrarian recovery; down 44.1% YTD, similar washout thesis, DeFi/NFT cycle recovery
Semiconductor mean-reversion hedge; 3x leverage inverse position, +507% extreme overextension targets decay, reduces drawdown from tech correction

outlook: Sector rotation thesis targets mean-reversion as capital rotates from mega-cap tech dominance into lagging sectors with attractive valuations. SOXL short (take-profit at 25% decline) locks in mean-reversion alpha; crypto longs (stops at 25% loss) capture washout recovery from -46%/-44% declines. TNA provides small-cap leverage for value catch-up with risk discipline (15% stop). Weekly rebalancing resets stops based on new close prices and sector momentum. Framework profits from multiple compression in semis, expansion in financials/healthcare, and contrarian crypto stabilization—mechanically different from prior earnings-growth and capex-cycle theses.
